en: Among other oddities, Hegel held that it was not the great mass of the Sun that accounted for its gravitational attraction. He instead thought it exerted attraction because it was luminous:

zh: 他的论证如下：牛顿认为重心因行星引力轻微偏移，因此不应把重心放在太阳中。但证明曲线运动命题需要轨道中心。牛顿假设吸引与被吸引物体相互吸引，二者仿佛绕共同重心旋转。共同重心是纯数学点。太阳力中心并非必然，而源于巨大的规模，这基于“每种力取决于质量”的假设。物理哲学指出，真正力中心是光源，太阳真正力与力量必须设定于此。
en: His argument went as follows: Newton believed that the centre of gravity should not be placed in the sun as it shifts slightly due to planetary attractions. However, a centre of orbits is required to prove propositions concerning curvilinear motion. Newton assumed the reciprocal attraction of attracting and attracted bodies, where both revolve as if about a common centre of gravity. The common centre of gravity is a purely mathematical point. The sun’s centre of force is not due to necessity but rather due to its massive size, which is based on the hypothesis that every force depends on mass. Physical philosophy suggests that the true centre of forces is the source of light, where the sun’s true force and power must be posited.

zh: 鉴于这些怪异且违背事实的观点，黑格尔天文学论述很快被遗忘并不奇怪。他在20 世纪享有声誉，是因为被视为现代共产主义形成中起作用。我们稍后叙述，在俄国革命前后，他被认为为共产主义学说贡献了组成部分。列宁说马克思和恩格斯捍卫哲学唯物主义。他们的观点体现在恩格斯的《路德维希·费尔巴哈》和《反杜林论》中，这些是阶级意识工人的指南。他说马克思扩展18 世纪唯物主义，用德国古典哲学尤其是导致费尔巴哈唯物主义的黑格尔体系丰富它。列宁说马克思主要成就是辩证法，即发展和人类知识相对性学说。自然科学最新发现，如镭和电子，证实马克思的辩证唯物主义。
en: Given his odd and counterfactual views, it is no surprise that Hegel’s account of astronomy soon passed into obscurity. Insofar as he had a positive reputation in the twentieth century, it is down to his being seen as having played a role in the formation of modern communism. We will recount later how, in the period around the Russian Revolution, he was credited with having contributed one of the component parts of communist doctrine. Lenin said that Marx and Engels defended philosophical materialism. Their views were exemplified in Engels,
and

, which served as handbooks for class-conscious workers. Marx, he said, expanded on eighteenth-century materialism, enriching it with German classical philosophy, particularly Hegel’s system, which had led to Feuerbach’s materialism. Lenin said Marx’s main achievement was dialectics, the doctrine of development and the relativity of human knowledge. Recent discoveries in natural science, such as radium and electrons, confirmed Marx’s dialectical materialism.

zh: 这种认可促使马克思主义者关注黑格尔，在此过程中，黑格尔对17、18 世纪唯物主义科学的原本被遗忘的反对意见在20 世纪部分复兴。我们稍后探讨苏联机械论者与受黑格尔影响的德博林学派争论。在这场争论中，德博林一方呼应黑格尔反对意见，即机械论依赖“外部”力量。在黑格尔那里，反对所谓外部力量的论点具有明确宗教性质，因为上帝行为不是外部、机械、任意或偶然的。根据实验哲学，上帝赋予物质的力量确实存在于物质内部，构成其本质。但力学无法理解，因为它只处理外部原因，不通过理性认识自然。
en: This stamp of approval encouraged Marxists to pay attention to him, and in the process, Hegel’s otherwise forgotten objections to the materialist science of the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries were partially revived in the twentieth century. We will later look at the debate between the Soviet Mechanists and the Hegel-influenced Deborin school. In this later debate, we see the Deborin side echoing some of Hegel’s objections that mechanics relies on ‘external’ forces. In Hegel’s case, the argument against what he saw as external forces was explicitly religious since God’s actions are not external, mechanical, arbitrary or fortuitous. According to experimental philosophy, the forces that God gave to matter truly dwell within it and constitute its nature. However, mechanics cannot understand this idea since it deals only with external causes and does not conceive nature through reason.

zh: 这种对“外部”力量的反复纠缠在20 世纪30 年代共产主义哲学文献中再次出现。例如美国马克思主义者埃默里写道：
en: This same harping on about ‘external’ forces reappears in the 1930s communist philosophical literature. For example, the American Marxist Emery writes:

zh: 原子所经历的正是如此。当发现原子是复杂运动系统时，机械论思维的自然科学家开始寻找系统“最终单位”（电子、亚电子等），以及使系统平衡的力。如果所有物质点只施加一种力，矛盾只能是外部的。因此力学中没有内在矛盾，没有对立统一。所有看似内在的矛盾被一分为二，外化为不同物质粒子体现的力冲突。这是牛顿力学遗产。但作用于某点的力，相对于该点也是外部的。力学承认力是物质点唯一属性，但非必然属性。可以抽去力，从而设想物质本身、完全静止的物质。既然静止被视为物质内在存在方式，运动必须来自外部来源——力。
en: This was what happened to the atom. When it was discovered that it is a system of complex movements, the mechanically minded natural scientist went on a search for the ‘last unit’ of the system (electrons, subelectrons etc), and the force which holds the system in equilibrium. If all material points exercise only one force, contradictions can only be external. Therefore no inner contradiction, no unity of opposites, is known in mechanics. All contradictions which seem to be immanent are cut in two, externalised into the conflict of forces embodied in different material particles. This is the heritage of Newton’s mechanics. But the force which acts in one point is external in relation to that point, too. Mechanics recognises force as the only attribute of the material point, but not as a necessary attribute. It might be abstracted, and matter as such, matter in complete rest, might be conceived. Since rest is taken as the immanent mode of existence of matter, movement has to come from an outside source – force.

zh: 埃默里对牛顿力学的困惑几乎与老黑格尔一样深。他重复黑格尔关于力是外部的旧批评，还错误阐述牛顿对力的定义。
牛顿力学不处理“物质点”，而处理物质体。点只是近似轨道天体的数学工具。他所说“物质点”混淆数学处理——用质心点近似物体——与物理学家理解这只是近似。把物体视为点质量只在引力场空间导数的阶数相对较低时成立。
en: Emery was almost as confused about Newtonian mechanics as old Hegel was. Not only does he echo Hegel’s old criticism about force being ‘external’, he also misstates the Newtonian definition of force.

Newtonian mechanics also does not deal with ‘material points’; it deals with material bodies. Points only arise as a mathematical tool for approximating the behaviour of orbiting bodies. His ‘material points’ confuse the mathematical treatment which approximates a body by a point at its centre of mass, with the understanding of physicists that this is just an approximation. The approximation that treats a body as a point mass is only valid up to relatively low spatial derivatives of the gravitational field.

zh: 例如卫星在罗希极限内运行，潮汐力会撕裂它——正如形成土星环的固体天体。亚原子物理学也是半生不熟胡言乱语。过去和现在都没有“亚电子”提案。
en: If a satellite, for example, were to orbit within what is called the Roche limit, then tidal forces would tear it apart – as happened to whatever solid bodies gave rise to Saturn’s rings. The subatomic physics was also half-digested nonsense. There was and is no proposal that there are sub-electrons.

zh: 构成世界的物质部分不是过程，而是旧义原子——刚性、孤立点，除拥有的力外无其他属性。每个点只能施加一种力，因此，只有不同点的力才在方向上有所不同。如果假想点施加多种力，机械论者会把它分成多个点。
en: The material parts of which the world consists are not processes, but atoms in the old sense of the word, rigid, isolated points which have no other attribute besides the forces they possess. Each point can exercise only one force, and therefore, only forces of different points are different in direction. If a hypothetical point would exercise several forces, the mechanist would divide it into several points.

zh: 这又是完全胡说。经典力学中质量或电荷能对所有其他质量或电荷施力。处理多体轨道时，每个物体对每个其他物体施力，力可向量相加。例如地球、月球、太阳彼此施力，无需把地球中心分成两个点处理吸引向月球和太阳的力。
en: This is again complete nonsense. In classical mechanics, masses or charges have the ability to exert forces on all other masses or charges. When dealing with the orbits of multiple bodies, each body exerts a force on each other, and these forces can be combined through vector addition. For instance, the Earth, Moon and Sun each exert forces on one another, and there is no need to divide the centre of the Earth into two points to handle the forces attracting it to the Moon and the Sun.

zh: 物理学家发现额外核力解释原子稳定性。他们预测高温氢聚变，实验证实。萨哈罗夫用静电力和强核力计算，而非神秘概念，研制氢弹。忽视核力会阻碍苏联核能进展。
en: Physicists discovered additional nuclear forces to explain atom stability. They predicted hydrogen fusion at high temperatures, which was confirmed by experiments. Sakharov used calculations of electrostatic and strong nuclear forces, not mystical concepts, to build his H-bomb. Disregard for nuclear forces would have hindered Soviet nuclear energy progress.

zh: 我们将在后面章节继续批判黑格尔式马克思解释。
en: We continue our critique of the Hegelian interpretation of Marx in later chapters.

zh: 杜·沙特莱
杜·沙特莱侯爵夫人（1706—1749）完成牛顿著作首部法语译本。她还出版第一本法语物理教科书《物理学基础》（Institutions Physiques）。
与伴侣伏尔泰一起，她是法国牛顿体系最重要倡导者之一。当时被视为哲学民族英雄的笛卡尔、牛顿和莱布尼茨之间存在全国性争议。在教科书导言中，她拒绝民族主义：
en: The Marquise du Châtelet (1706–49) produced the first French translation of Newton’s work. She also published the first French physics textbook,

Along with her companion Voltaire, she was one of the most important advocates of the Newtonian system in France at a time when there existed considerable national controversy between what were seen as national champions in philosophy: Descartes, Newton and Leibniz. In the introduction to her textbook, she rejects this nationalism and writes:

zh: 追求真理是唯一不应让爱国之情占上风的事；牛顿和笛卡尔的观点竟成为某种民族事务，这无疑非常不幸。
en: The search for truth is the only thing in which the love of your country must not prevail, and it is surely very unfortunate that the opinions of Newton and of Descartes have become a sort of national affair.

zh: 我们纳入杜·沙特莱，是因为她除翻译牛顿外，还阐明当今理解的牛顿物理学。她的教科书仍受莱布尼茨影响，
包含许多如今被视为相当形而上学的关于方法论的论点。
en: We are including du Châtelet in this account because, in addition to translating Newton, she contributed to clarifying Newtonian physics as it is now understood. Her textbook retains considerable influence from Leibniz
and includes a number of what would now be seen as rather metaphysical arguments about methodology.

zh: 她开篇为物理学使用假设辩护，在此与牛顿不同。她认为，只有以宗教经院哲学家难以理解且无意义术语形式出现的假设才应摒弃。
en: She starts out by defending the use of hypotheses in physics, differentiating herself from Newton in this. She argues that it is only hypotheses in the form of the unintelligible and meaningless jargon of the religious schoolmen that must be rejected.

zh: 例如中世纪经院哲学假设：植物生长因为拥有植物灵魂。她说，该假设给出生长的表面原因，但进一步追问便无意义：因为它不帮助我们理解所寻求的植物生长如何运作。
但她认为假设仍不可或缺。针对牛顿学派，她指出天文学进步严重依赖假设。若天文学家等待“真正理论”说明行星运动规律，就不会有进展。相反，天文学家把日心说作为初始工作假设：
en: As an example of this, she gives the medieval scholastic hypothesis that plants grow because they have a vegetative soul. This hypothesis, she says, gives an apparent cause for growth, but when one pursues it further, it is meaningless: ‘because it contains nothing that helps us to understand how the vegetation of which I seek the cause operates’.

But she held that hypotheses remain essential. To the Newtonians, she objects that advance in astronomy has depended heavily on hypotheses. She says that if astronomers had waited for ‘the true theory’ of what regulated planetary motion, no progress would have been made. Instead, astronomers took heliocentrism as an initial working hypothesis:
body.review: 此处原作者写heliocentrism（日心说），但紧接着引文说的是被哥白尼放弃的托勒密假说，二者不一致。正文保留原作者用词，不静默改为地心说。

zh: 因此，他们开始用这一被称为托勒密假设的假说解释和预测现象，直到其推论与观测相比存在无法克服的困难，且无法根据该假说构建与天象相符的星历表，这才促使哥白尼彻底放弃它，检验相反假说；该假说与天象如此吻合，其确凿性目前接近证明；没有天文学家敢再采纳托勒密假说。
en: Thus, they began to explain and to predict phenomena by this hypothesis, called Ptolemy’s hypothesis, until the insurmountable difficulties of the consequences that derived from it when compared with observations, and the impossibility of constructing tables according to this hypothesis which were in accord with the phenomena of the sky, brought Copernicus to abandon it entirely and to test the opposite hypothesis, which is so much in agreement with the phenomena, that its certitude is at present not far from demonstration; and that no astronomer dares adopt that of Ptolemy.

zh: 因此假设在科学中必须占一席之地，因为它们促进真理发现并提供新视角；因为一旦提出假设，人们常做实验验证它是否成立，若没有假设，这些实验根本不会被想到。如果实验证实它，且它不仅解释原定现象，还使所有推论与观测一致，其概率增长到我们无法拒绝同意，几乎等同于证明。
en: Hypotheses must then find a place in the sciences, since they promote the discovery of truth and offer new perspectives; for when a hypothesis is once posed, experiments are often done to ascertain if it is a good one, experiments which would never have been thought of without it. If it is found that these experiments confirm it and that it not only explains the phenomenon that one had proposed to explain with it but also that all the consequences drawn from it agree with the observations, its probability grows to such a point that we cannot refuse our assent to it, and that is almost equivalent to a demonstration.

zh: 她为假设实用性制定规则：
en: She constructs several rules for hypotheses to be useful.

zh: 1. 不能违背充足理由原则。2. 必须对现有事实有确定知识，以免把假设建立在狭隘基础上；否则假设很快被忽略事实推翻。3. 在获得无可辩驳证据前，不能把假设当作真理本身；必须冷静评估概率，不坚持他人接受。
en: 1. It must not contradict the principle of sufficient reason. 2. You must have certain knowledge of the facts as they stand so as not to base your hypothesis on a narrow foundation. Otherwise, your hypothesis will soon be overthrown by facts that you neglected to pay attention to. 3. A hypothesis must not be passed off as the truth itself before one has irrefutable evidence to support it. You have to be sober in your estimate of the probability of your hypotheses and not insist that others must accept it.

zh: 这些观点今天多数科学家接受。另一方面，她保留莱布尼茨若干本质形而上学思想，认为莱布尼茨提出的连续性原理是物理学基本概念。该原理说，自然不突然变化，任何存在从一种状态到另一种状态必须经过所有中间状态。
en: These are views which would be accepted by most scientists today. On the other hand, she retains a number of essentially metaphysical ideas from Leibniz, holding that the principle of continuity, introduced by Leibniz, was a fundamental concept in physics. It stated that nature does not change suddenly, and any being cannot move from one state to another without passing through all the intermediate states between them.

zh: 像莱布尼茨这样的古典物理学家，把理想曲线的抽象连续性与物质世界属性混淆。“真实”连续体和连续可微函数是微积分必需的抽象。这些抽象使古典物理学家能准确预测大尺寸物体运动。他们假设物质世界也有理想属性，如数学抽象。
en: Classical physicists, like Leibniz, confused the abstract continuity of ideal curves with the properties of the material world. The ‘real’ continuum and continuous differential functions are abstractions necessary for differential calculus. These abstractions allowed classical physicists to make accurate predictions about the motion of substantially sized bodies. They assumed that the material world also had ideal properties, like the mathematical abstractions they used.

zh: 20 世纪量子力学表明自然确实发生跳跃，但不能因此指责杜·沙特莱缺乏远见。直到1905 年，大多数科学家都会同意她。
en: The advent of quantum mechanics in the twentieth century showed that nature does in fact make jumps, but one cannot fairly criticize du Châtelet for her lack of foresight. On this, she was just expressing a view with which most scientists would have agreed until 1905.

zh: 杜·沙特莱认为，原子既然有限大小，就不可能是物质基本元素，因为基本元素必须是点粒子。
en: Du Châtelet argues that atoms, insofar as they are of finite size, cannot be the fundamental elements of matter since the fundamental elements would have to be point particles.

zh: 现在，由于延展存在物的可分性不矛盾，原子不可分性不能被视为必然；因此必须归结到简单存在物。
en: Now, as there is no contradiction in the divisibility of extended beings, the indivisibility of atoms cannot be accepted as necessary; thus, one must come to simple beings.

zh: 她伟大贡献是提出比牛顿更清晰的能量概念。
en: Her great contribution was introducing a clearer idea of energy than there is in Newton.

zh: 描述摆实验时，牛顿说：因为几何学家熟知，摆体在最低点的速度与它下落所描绘弧的弦成正比。
en: In the course of describing experiments with pendulums, Newton makes the striking remark ‘

en: It is clear that from this relationship between chords and velocities, one could deduce another equivalence relation/conservation law – that of the equivalence of potential and kinetic energy. But Newton fails to formulate this explicitly as a conservation law. The conservation relation can readily be demonstrated using the form of geometric argument that Newton uses in the

zh: 牛顿只明确动量守恒，而非能量守恒。他说螺丝施加的力与转动手柄的手施加的力成正比；槌子对楔子施加的力与楔子推进量成正比。这些原理适用于所有机械。更普遍：
en: Newton only explicitly identifies a conservation of momentum, not a conservation of energy. He said that the force applied by a screw is proportional to the force applied by the hand that turns the handle. The force applied by a mallet to a wedge is proportional to the progress of the wedge. These principles apply to all machines. More generally:

zh: 我仅想通过这些例子展示运动第三定律的广泛适用性和确定性。因为如果我们综合作用体的力和速度估算作用，同时综合障碍物各部分速度以及摩擦、内聚力、重量和加速度产生的阻力估算反作用，那么使用各类机械时作用与反作用始终相等。
en: I was only willing to show by those examples the great extent and certainty of the third Law of motion. For if we estimate the action of the agent from its force and velocity conjunctly, and likewise the reaction of the impediment conjunctly from the velocities of its several parts, and from the forces of resistance arising from the attrition, cohesion, weight, and acceleration of those parts, the action and reaction in the use of all sorts of machines will be found always equal to one another.

zh: 这再次接近理想简单机械能量守恒。他说：

en: which corresponds to the later definition of work as force times distance, saying work in equals work out for an ideal simple machine (disregarding friction etc.).

zh: 牛顿有动量守恒和力等价性，但未看到现代功或能量表述。
en: What Newton had was conservation of momentum and equivalence of forces, but without seeing through to the modern formulation of work or energy.

zh: 杜·沙特莱在牛顿基础上进步，倡导所谓“活力”，即我们今天所说的能量。她在此赋予“力”一词多重含义，但正确指出这种“力”必须与速度平方成正比：
en: Du Châtelet advanced on Newton and was a proponent of what she called
, what we would now call energy. She overloads the term
here, but she gets right that it must be proportional to the square of velocity:

zh: 活力或许是物理学中唯一尽管有实验证明仍有人异议的论点；因为若问拒绝者，两个质量相等物体撞击两个相同障碍物，速度分别为4 和3，会产生什么效果，他们会回答：一个产生16 的效果，另一个产生9 的效果。现在容易看出，无论他们随后对这一为真理之力所迫作出的承认加以何种区分和修饰，效果是平方，因此产生效果的力必须是平方的。
en: may be the only point of physics which some still dispute while acknowledging the experiments that prove it; for if you ask those who reject them what would be the effects of two bodies equal in mass on two equal obstacles, but the speeds of which are 4 and 3, they will answer that one will be an effect, as 16 and the other as 9. Now, it is easy to see that, whatever distinction and whatever modification they next bring to this acknowledgment that the force of truth draws from them, it always remains certain that the effect being squared, there must have been a squared force to produce it.

zh: 她说牛顿得出结论：运动总体不守恒，相反：
en: She says that Newton had concluded that there was no overall conservation law regarding motion and that he believed instead that:

zh: 宇宙中运动不断减少；最后我们的太阳系终有一天需要造物主重新塑造；这一结论是物质惯性以及牛顿先生所持“力量等于动量”观点的必然结果。
en: motion is constantly diminishing in the universe; and lastly that our system will some day need to be formed anew by its Author, and this conclusion was a necessary consequence of the inertia of matter, and the opinion held by M. Newton that the quantity of force was equal to the quantity of motion.

zh: 她声称牛顿要求持续奇迹维持运动，并反驳：
en: She claimed that in this Newton was demanding continuous miracles to sustain motion, asserting instead that:

zh: 但当把质量与速度平方乘积视为力时，容易证明活力始终不变，尽管宇宙每个瞬间动量可能变化；所有情况下，尤其是我刚引用的牛顿先生论点中，活力保持不变。
en: But when the product of the mass by the square of the speed is taken as force, it is easy to prove that the forces vives always remain the same, although the quantity of motion varies perhaps at each instant in the universe, and in all the cases, and especially in that which I have just cited from M. Newton, the forces vives stay invariable.

zh: 这是能量守恒原理首次明确表述。卢克莱修“无中不能生有”延伸到运动。杜·沙特莱的继任者拉格朗日（1736—1813）和兰金（1820—1872）扩展该思想，拉格朗日通过动能和势能概念系统化无摩擦系统力学。最终兰金明确把能量守恒表述为自然定律。将其概括为定律的障碍是摩擦损耗。拉格朗日能用势能和动能表述支配行星轨道的定律，但应用于地球系统不明显，因为摩擦使物体减速。认识到热是另一种能量形式，抵消动能损失，才确立能量守恒一般原理。马克思写《资本论》时这些思想已牢固确立，我们稍后展示守恒原理如何支撑他的分析。
en: This is the first explicit formulation of the principle of energy conservation. Lucretius’ nothing from nothing extended to motion. Du Châtelet’s successors Lagrange (1736–1813) and Rankine (1820–72) extended the idea, Lagrange by systematizing the mechanical dynamics of frictionless systems in terms of kinetic and potential energy. Finally, Rankine explicitly states the conservation of energy as a law of nature. The obstacle to generalizing it as a law had been in dealing with frictional losses. While Lagrange could formulate a law governing the planets’ orbits in terms of potential and kinetic energy, it was far less obvious that it could be applied to systems on the Earth, where friction slowed things down. The recognition that heat was another form of energy which balanced the loss of kinetic energy, allowed a general principle of energy conservation to be established. These ideas had been well established by the time Marx wrote
, and we will later show how conservation principles underpin his analysis.

zh: 机械决定论
亚里士多德把原因分为动力因和目的因。动力因从现在到未来，目的因是未来状态导致现在事件。
en: Aristotle categorized causes into efficient and final. Efficient causes work from present to future, while final causes are states in the future that cause events in the present.

zh: 牛顿机械唯物主义依赖动力因。所有天体当前位置和动量完全决定未来位置和动量。其他天体存在使计算复杂，但不改变决定论。其他力如静电力和磁力在19 世纪末发现，但力学不变。
en: Newton’s mechanical materialism relies on efficient causes. The current positions and momenta of all celestial bodies fully dictate their future positions and momenta. The existence of other celestial bodies may make the calculations more complex, but they do not alter determinism. Other forces, such as electrostatic and magnetic forces, were discovered in the late nineteenth century, but the mechanics remained the same.
body.review: 原书将静电力与磁力的发现说成19世纪末；本章前文已谈古代琥珀和磁石现象，二者存在明显年代不一致，译文照录底本。

zh: 机械决定论悖论：既包含动力因，也包含目的因。地球今天位置和动量决定明天位置，也限定昨天必然位置。
时刻的力决定运动速度。天文学家可向前积分推未来，向后积分推过去。
en: Mechanical determinism is paradoxical because it implies both efficient and final cause. The position and momentum of the Earth today determine where it will be tomorrow and constrain where it must have been yesterday. Forces
dictate the rate of motion. Astronomers can infer future planetary positions by integrating forward and past positions by integrating backward.

zh: 力学定律具有时间对称性。反转时间维度并反转物体运动，时间便倒流。动力因与目的因区别不再重要。太阳系当前状态既决定过去也决定未来。用拉格朗日或哈密顿力学表述——基于完整轨迹——时更清晰。变分法是微分学延伸，用于推导轨迹。
en: The laws of mechanics possess time symmetry. This means that reversing the time dimension and movements of the bodies cause time to run backward. The distinction between efficient and final cause becomes irrelevant. The present state of the solar system constrains its past and future. This concept becomes clearer when using formulations of mechanics by Lagrange or Hamilton, which reason about complete trajectories. Variational calculus, an extension of differential calculus, is used to reason about these trajectories.

zh: 哈密顿和拉格朗日力学借光学类比发展。若光束以一定角度射入水中，会弯曲。反之，把直尺部分浸入水中，直尺看起来弯曲。这是光在空气/水界面折射结果。古典力学家知道，尽管从直尺到眼睛路径弯曲，光“选择”路径使光子穿越距离时间最小。由于水比空气密，光在水中更慢，因此到眼睛最快路径是光子在空气中花费时间比直线传播更多的路径。
en: The Hamiltonian and Lagrangian mechanics arose by analogy with optics. If a light beam is shone into water at an angle, it bends. Conversely, if you place a straight ruler partially under water, the ruler appears bent. This is a consequence of the bending of light on the air/water boundary. The classical mechanists knew that although light from the ruler to your eye takes a bent path, the path it ‘decides’ to take is such that it minimizes the time a photon will take to traverse the distance. Since water is denser than air, light travels more slowly through it, and in consequence the quickest route to your eye is one in which the photon spends more of its time going through air than it would were it to go on a straight line.

zh: 这条光学定律称为费马原理，似乎已动摇朴素时间、因果观念。从直尺顶端出发的光线，怎会知道走哪条路最快到达眼睛？
en: This law of optics, known as Fermat’s principle, already seemed to undermine naive notions of time, cause and effect. How could the light ray setting out from the tip of the ruler know what path to take to reach your eye fastest?

zh: 欧拉变分法可证明
光遵循轨迹恰好是可能最快路径。从时间看，光遵循最简单路径。欧拉学生拉格朗日随后意识到，牛顿定律描述的轨迹或许也可同样处理。但此时最简单路径不能只是最快，必须在另一意义上简单。
en: Euler’s calculus of variation can be used to show

that the trajectory the light follows turns out to be the quickest that it could take. From the standpoint of time, light follows the simplest possible path. One of Euler’s students, Lagrange, then had the insight that perhaps the trajectories laid down by Newton’s laws might be treated the same way. But in this case the simplest path could not simply be the quickest. It had to be simple in another sense.

zh: 他得出答案：自然遵循最小作用量原理。作用量是科学隐喻，其精确数学定义至少可以说并非显而易见。
拉格朗日力学是牛顿定律数学推论。使用拉格朗日方法，许多问题计算更容易。它显示自然如何对轨迹施加约束，类似光路径。单个粒子轨迹容易想象，但一对或多粒子较难。
en: The answer he came up with was that nature follows the course of least action. Action here is a scientific metaphor whose precise mathematical definition is non-obvious to say the least.

Lagrangian mechanics is a mathematical implication of Newton’s laws. Using Lagrange’s method, computations for many problems are easier. It shows how nature imposes constraints on trajectories, similar to light’s path. While it’s easy to visualize a single particle’s trajectory, it’s harder to understand a pair or a multiplicity of particles.

zh: 学校数学中，我们学习y 作为x 函数的轨迹，绘制抛物线，特征方程
。这简单直观，因为x、y 代表方格纸水平垂直轴距离。用x、y 坐标数学描述二维运动也直观。我们直观理解二维、三维。接受生活在三维空间，图画在二维纸张。但六维或十二维空间是什么？
en: In school maths, one is taught about trajectories in which
is a function of
. We learned to plot parabolas and learned that these have characteristic equations of the form
. This is all simple and easy to visualize since
represent distances along the horizontal and vertical axes on a sheet of graph paper. It is also straightforward to express movement in two dimensions mathematically in terms of

coordinates. We have an intuitive notion of what two dimensions or three dimensions means. We accept that we live in three-dimensional space and that we draw our pictures on two-dimensional sheets of paper. But what would a six-dimensional or a twelve-dimensional space be?

zh: 十二维轨迹是什么？经典物理学家处理多粒子系统或多个耦合独立运动物体时，借助抽象“位形空间”。
en: What is a twelve-dimensional trajectory? When the classical physicists dealt with systems of many particles or multiple coupled independently moving bodies, they resorted to an abstract form of space they called

zh: 考虑单个运动粒子。它在三维空间的位置和速度可写成六个数：三个x、y、z 坐标，另外三个
表示三个基本方向速度分量。数学上是六维系统。两个粒子则十二个数，等等。这组抽象维度称为位形空间。
en: Consider a single moving particle. Its position and velocity in three-dimensional space can be written down as six numbers, three to give its
coordinates and another three,

, which mean its velocity components in the three cardinal dimensions. Mathematically, this is a six-dimensional system. If you have two particles, you have twelve numbers etc. This set of abstract dimensions is called configuration space.
body.review: 作者这里把位置与速度合在一起称为configuration space（位形空间）。通常位形空间只包含位置类广义坐标；位置与速度合成的状态空间与之有别。下文沿用作者术语，并保留这一辨析。

zh: 力学抽象空间与欧几里得真实空间有何共同点？
en: What does the abstract space of mechanics have in common with the real space that we learn about from Euclid?

zh: 当我们实际只有纸上符号
时，从何意义谈维度和轨迹？这些符号与真实空间如何关联？回到二维例子，可见方格纸位置与数对等价性有操作基础。可数二维网格线，把纸上点转换为x、y 坐标；反之，根据两个数字在纸上标点。建筑和测量实践在古典几何与物理世界间建立联系。建筑图纸用于建造与图纸保持欧几里得相似关系的更大尺度建筑。对应关系通过实践确立。
en: In what sense can we speak of dimensions and trajectories when all we actually have are signs on paper,

? How do the signs and squiggles relate to real space? If we return to the two-dimensional example, we can see that there is an operational basis for the equivalence of positions on graph paper and pairs of numbers. You can count grid lines in the two dimensions to convert a dot on the paper to

coordinates or, conversely, you learn to plot a point on the paper given two written numbers. Architectural and surveying practice created a link between classical geometry and the physical world. Architectural diagrams were used to build larger buildings sharing Euclidean similarity. This correspondence was established through practice.

zh: 《原理》中牛顿仍用古典欧几里得几何。到18 世纪中叶，用笛卡尔坐标推理物理成为标准。这涉及建模物质实践转变：不再用直尺圆规，而用代数。欧几里得方法可以得到模拟式结果。按特定半径几何作图，沿新画线测量得结果。若想比直尺更精确，必须设计基于直角三角形的毕达哥拉斯过程，再明确计算平方和平方根。
en: In the

, Newton still used classical Euclidean geometry. By the mid-eighteenth century it becomes standard to reason about physics in terms of Cartesian coordinates. This involves a shift in the material practice of modelling. Instead of using the ruler and compass, one uses algebra. With Euclidean techniques one can get analogue results. You follow the geometric construction using specific radii and then obtain a result measuring along new lines that you have drawn. If you want the result to be more accurate than you can manage with a ruler, you have to devise some ultimately Pythagorean process of construction in terms of right triangles, after which you explicitly compute squares and square roots.

zh: 物理学家用笛卡尔方法推导行星轨道方程。天文学家使用拉格朗日方法参数化实际轨道。方程与轨道关系不立即清楚，但可学会比旧几何更精确高效的方法。两种情况下，我们都有在地球上制作的、关于月球运动的实体纸面模型。
en: The physicist used the Cartesian method to derive an equation for a planetary trajectory. The astronomer used Lagrangian methods to parameterize the actual orbit. While the relationship between equation and orbit isn’t immediately clear, we can learn to use methods that are more accurate and efficient than old geometric approaches. In both cases, we have a physical paper model of the Moon’s motion on Earth.

zh: 回到维度含义。人类实践语境中，维度与身体运动相关。看18 世纪爱丁堡新城地图。
这需要启蒙运动所培育的感受方式按笛卡尔几何公设构建城市环境，但同样方法更大规模用于绘制整个国家地图，把每个道路交叉口、山丘或桥梁标在笛卡尔网格上。
en: Let us return to what a dimension means. In the context of human practice, dimensions are related to bodily movement. Look at a map of the eighteenth-century New Town of Edinburgh.

It took an Enlightenment sensibility to construct the urban environment according to the geometric postulates of Descartes, but the same procedure, writ large, was to be employed to map whole nations, plotting every road junction, hill or bridge on Cartesian grids.

zh: 沿乔治街向东走，获得一个维度。左转进入北城堡街，获得第二维度——南北。使维度区别的是独立性：向北走不向东移动。若目的地圣安德鲁广场，仍需沿皇后街三个街区，然后左转北圣大卫街。向北步行未减少向东还需街区数。
en: Walking east along George Street gives me one dimension. I can then turn left into North Castle Street. This gives me a second dimension, the north-south one. What makes the dimensions distinct is that walking north does not move me in any way east. If my destination was St Andrew Square, I would still have to go three blocks along Queen Street and then turn left into North St David Street. My walk to the north did not reduce the number of blocks I still had to go east.

zh: 南北维度与东西维度之所以不同，在于二者的独立性。沿一个轴运动，不会使我沿另一个轴向前。两个维度就是我沿街漫步时的自由度。拉格朗日方程中的变量
，也是多粒子系统的独立自由度。其中
表示第一个粒子在x方向的位置，
表示第二个粒子在y方向的位置，而
表示第n个粒子在z方向的运动。所有这些量都可以独立变化，因此，在一种抽象的比喻意义上，它们就是维度。所以，位形空间中的一个点，就是所有粒子的位置和速度的一种特定组合；位形空间中的一条轨迹，必定是这些点的序列。
en: What makes the north-south and east-west dimensions distinct is their independence. Movement on one axis gets me no further along towards the other. The two dimensions are my degrees of freedom in a street stroll. The variables in the equations of Lagrange,
, are also independent degrees of freedom for the multi-particle system. The
denotes position of the first particle in the
direction,
the position of the second particle in the
direction, and
the motion of the nth particle in the

direction. All of these can vary independently, and so in an abstract metaphorical sense they are dimensions. A point in configuration space is therefore a particular combination of positions and velocities for all particles. A trajectory in configuration space must then be a sequence of these points.

zh: 关键点：拉格朗日方程规定整个多粒子系统在多维位形空间中唯一时间轨迹。拉格朗日决定论对全部运动的限定，与对单个物体运动的限定同样严格。整个宇宙有位形空间——所有原子位置和速度。穿越位形空间的宇宙轨迹是实空间中所有个体轨迹的乘积。
en: Now here is the crucial point:

children: the equations of Lagrange specify a unique time trajectory of the entire multi-particle system through multi-dimensional configuration space.

en: Lagrangian determinism specifies the totality of all movement just as strongly as it specifies the movement of one body. The entire universe has a configuration space – the positions and velocities of all the atoms. The universal trajectory through configuration space is the product of all the individual trajectories in real space.

zh: 若刚接触力学，需要时间理解。
en: If you are new to mechanics and the mechanical approach, this takes some time to sink in.

zh: 由此，宇宙在位形空间中也有唯一轨迹，即贯穿时间的最小作用量路径。这种决定论足以令加尔文或诺克斯汗颜。
en: It follows that the universe too has a unique trajectory through configuration space, a path of least action throughout time. This is a determinism to shame Calvin or Knox.

zh: 2013 年2 月15 日，俄罗斯中部工业城市车里雅宾斯克上空出现炽热火球。比太阳亮，户外市民感到皮肤灼热。幸运的是，当量为500千吨的爆炸发生在约30,000 米高空。尽管如此，许多人受伤住院。报告闪光盲、辐射烧伤、皮肤剥落、爆炸创伤和飞溅碎片割伤。冲击波破坏数百平方公里。数千栋公寓楼、学校、医院和工厂需修复。
en: On 15 February 2013, over the major industrial city of Chelyabinsk in central Russia, an intense ball of fire appeared in the sky. Brighter than the Sun, citizens out in the open could feel its intense heat on their skin. Luckily for the residents of Chelyabinsk, the 500 kiloton detonation took place at an altitude of about 30,000 metres. Nonetheless, many were injured and hospitalized. Flash blindness, radiation burns, peeling the skin off, blast injuries and cuts from flying debris were reported. Shock-wave damage spread over hundreds of square kilometres. Thousands of blocks of flats, schools, hospitals and factories had to be repaired.

zh: 原因？不是自1960 年代以来瞄准车里雅宾斯克的美国民兵导弹，而是来自小行星带的20 米岩石。它沿最小作用量路径在太阳系运行无数时代，最终在该市上空终结。目击者见它从西方低空、朝阳方向出现。受开普勒定律约束，它在返回小行星带途中离开近日点，速度极快。以60,000 km/h 沿双曲线路径，若未擦过大气，会飞回外层空间。但动能瞬间转化为热、辐射和冲击波。若入射角更陡、爆炸更低，车里雅宾斯克会被夷平。
en: The cause? Not one of the American Minuteman missiles pointed at Chelyabinsk since the 1960s, but a 20-metre lump of rock from the asteroid belt. Its path of least action, looping through the solar system for countless ages, terminated over the city. Witnesses saw it emerge in the low Western sky, from the direction of the rising sun. Fleeing its closest solar approach on its way back to the asteroid belt, bound by Kepler’s law, it had to be travelling fast. It raced along at 60,000 km/h on a hyperbolic path that, had it not grazed the atmosphere, would have led it back into outer space. Instead, kinetic energy flashed into heat, radiation and blast. Had the angle of approach been steeper and the explosion lower, Chelyabinsk would have been flattened.
body.review: 底本将“西方低空”与“日出方向”并列，方向表述存在矛盾；译文保留两者，不擅自替作者改写。

zh: 但轨道动力学中没有“本可能”。它的路径不可能不同。用古典语言，它注定与城市擦肩而过。尽管车里雅宾斯克幸免，仍是警示。宙斯或许投掷雷霆，法埃顿也可能无预警坠落。
en: But in orbital dynamics, there are no might-have-beens. There was no way that its path could have been any different. To revert to classical language, it was
to narrowly spare the city. Though Chelyabinsk lived, it was still a salutary reminder. Zeus may hurl his bolts, or the Phaethon may fall without warning.

zh: NASA 试图预警。“哨兵地球”项目搜寻危险小行星。但车里雅宾斯克超火流星未被NASA 发现。
en: NASA tries to grant warnings. Their ‘Sentry Earth’ project searches out dangerous asteroids. Yet Chelyabinsk’s superbolide had not been spotted by NASA.

zh: 搜索受望远镜限制。即使已探测天体，也无法精确预测，只能给概率。可访问网站查看风险。例如小行星2020 VV 估计2044 至2111 年间撞击概率0.23%。幸运的是仅36 千吨。但既然轨道确定性，为何只给概率？2021 年NASA 用拉格朗日力学送凤凰号着陆火星，准时着陆，距目标几米。既然NASA 能做到，为何小行星撞击像掷骰子？
en: Searches are bounded by the available telescopes. Even for the ones they have spotted, no exact predictions are made. They instead give probabilities. You can go to their website and view the risks they have spotted. For example, an asteroid called 2020 VV is estimated to have a 0.23 per cent chance of striking us sometime between 2044 and 2111. Luckily, this would only be a 36 kiloton hit. But why, given the determinism of orbits, is the estimate only in terms of probabilities? In 2021, NASA sent Phoenix Lander to Mars using Lagrangian mechanics. It landed on time, within a few metres of its intended destination. If NASA can do that, why are asteroid collisions a game of dice?
body.review: 本段风险概率、时间范围、当量和任务名称／年份均为原书陈述，按底本保留，未作为当前NASA风险评估或任务记录重新核验。

zh: 2020 年10 月至12 月，NASA 对12 米天体2020 VV 观测79 次，用数百万公里外望远镜。NASA 必须根据观测估计位置和速度，但屏幕确切位置不确定。初始信息模糊，预测也模糊。
en: NASA has made seventy-nine observations of 2020 VV, an object 12 metres across, between October and December 2020. These observations were made using telescopes from millions of kilometres away. NASA must estimate the object’s positions and velocity based on these observations, but the exact position on the screen is uncertain. As a result, the initial information is fuzzy, and the predictions made based on this information will also be fuzzy.

zh: 据我们理解，宏观运动定律确定性。但鉴于无知——未观测现象和观测不精确——似乎存在偶然。未观测流星可能任何瞬间撞击。已观测流星最多知道某天经过的窗口。
en: To the best of our understanding, the macroscopic laws of motion are deterministic. But given our ignorance, both in terms of things we have not yet observed and in terms of the imprecision of our observations, there appears to be an element of chance. An unobserved meteor may hit at any instant. For the observed ones, we know at most a window through which they will pass on a given day.

zh: 拉格朗日唯物主义绝对决定论，表面随机性是无知产物。现代唯物主义是否必然蕴含决定论，以及决定论意味着什么，我们稍后回到。现在考察经典力学构建的认知结构。
en: Lagrangian materialism is absolutely deterministic, and apparent randomness is the product of our ignorance. Whether modern materialism necessarily implies determinism, and what such determinism means, is something we will return to. For now, let us examine the structure of knowing created by classical mechanics.

zh: 我们面对多层次算法建模过程。微分学和变分法是转换公式的程序。借助它们，牛顿初始定律可转化为包含势能和动能的欧拉–拉格朗日运动方程。现代术语中，这些方程是一类软件。
en: What we have is a multilayered process of algorithmic modelling. The differential calculus and the calculus of variations are procedures by which formulae can be transformed. Using them, Newton’s initial laws could be transformed into Euler-Lagrange equations of motion, including terms for potential and kinetic energy. In modern language, these equations are a class of software.

zh: 它们相对高级，因为涉及泛函——转换其他函数的函数。规则作用：把广义坐标表示动能和势能的函数转换为新运动函数。
en: They are relatively high-level software since they involve functionals, or functions which transform other functions. They are rules for taking functions which give kinetic and potential energies in terms of generalized coordinates and transforming these into new functions of motion.

People use tools – telescopes, notepads, keyboards, processors etc. – to determine initial positions and check final positions.

zh: 科学家通过实践验证知识。火箭科学中，实践验证了被模拟系统在本体论上的实在性。火星曾是红点，如今我们看岩石沙丘视频，听火星微风。
en: Scientists use practice to verify knowledge. In rocket science, practice has verified the ontological reality of simulated systems. Mars was once just a red dot in the sky, but now we watch videos of his rocks and dunes up close and hear Martian breezes.

en: For modelling the real world, procedures for constructing Lagrangians or Hamiltonians are means of production for models, not models themselves. Actual models are built through collective labour processes and observation. They are not mere ‘thought objects’, but localized physical processes that consume energy and evolve through time as computations are performed.

zh: 相对于不具有某种运动的事物而言，以及在一切同等分享该运动的事物之间，该运动不起作用，就仿佛不存在一样。因此，一艘满载货物的船驶离威尼斯，途经科孚、克里特、塞浦路斯，前往阿勒颇。威尼斯、科孚、克里特等地静止不动，不随船运动；但对于船上装载的袋子、箱子和包裹，以及船本身而言，从威尼斯到叙利亚的运动等于没有运动，丝毫不会改变它们彼此之间的关系。原因就在于，这一运动为它们所共有，它们全都同等地分享这一运动。伽利略·伽利莱：《关于两大世界体系的对话》（1632）（Robert C. Kuhmann，2006），第41页，
。对于一个简单的可动物体，只能有一种、而不能有更多的运动天然适合它；其他运动，它只能偶然地、通过参与而具有。因此，当一个人沿船甲板行走时，他自身的运动是步行，而把他带到港口的运动则是他所参与的运动；因为若不是船通过自身运动将他带到那里，他单靠步行永远无法抵达。伽利莱：《关于两大世界体系的对话》，第45页。
en: Relatively to things that lack it, and among things which all share equally in any motion, it does not act and is as if it did not exist. Thus the goods with which a ship is laden leaving Venice, pass by Corfu, by Crete, by Cyprus and go to Aleppo. Venice, Corfu, Crete etc., stand still and do not move with the ship; but as to the sacks, boxes and bundles with which the boat is laden and with respect to the ship itself, the motion from Venice to Syria is as nothing, and in no way alters their relations among themselves. This is so because it is common to all of them and all share equally in it. Galileo Galilei,
